description:
Classic Truck Bike, with unique "Steer-tru" system, large "fixed to frame" perforated steel cargo basket, and built in parking stand. 20 x 2.125 front wheel, 26x2.125 rear wheel

Mens Low Gravity Bike w/ Basket. Classic Delivery Bike that has been seen from the streets of New York to the Movie Studios in Los Angeles for more than 50 years. Many people refer to them as "Truck Bikes". In fact, these Worksman Classics have even been featured in some big time movies with stars including Cher, Adam Sandler and Goldie Hawn riding them. More important are the benefits businesses gain from using these bikes to deliver small packages in Urban or campus settings. See how this young entrepreneur got started using Worksman Low Gravity Delivery Bikes! Worksman Low Gravity Bikes have a unique "Balance Tru" Steering System whereby the handlebars turn but the huge newly designed standard 24 x 17 x 12" perforated steel basket does not. This allows bulkier loads to be transported. Also, Low Gravity Bikes have the unique built-in parking stand. (for Unisex LG Version, select appropriate frame style in drop down options menu) Shown are both the LGB (mens style frame) and LGG Unisex style frame). Large front Perforated Steel Basket is standard equipment on the Low Gravity Bicycle. An absolute American and New York Classic Design that we have proudly offered for over 60 years!!!!!! Worksman Industrial Bikes are proudly made in our Solar Powered New York City (Ozone Park) factory Doesn't get for American Classic than this!
